name: crowdsec_dev
label: CrowdSec Cyber Threat Intelligence
description: Integrates CrowdSec's CTI and Service APIs to provide IP reputation analysis, threat intelligence lookup, and automated security list management. Enables investigation of malicious IPs, blocklist/allowlist operations, and firewall integration for threat response.

fields.title: CTI API Key
fields.name: cti_api_key
fields.tooltip: Get your CTI API key from CrowdSec Console. Required for smoke test and CTI operations.

fields.title: Service API Base URL
fields.name: service_api_base_url
fields.tooltip: https://admin.api.crowdsec.net/v1. Only needed if using Service API operations.

fields.title: Service API Key
fields.name: service_api_key
fields.tooltip: Get your Service API key from CrowdSec Console. Required only for Service API operations like blocklist management.

fields.title: Verify SSL
fields.name: verify_ssl
fields.tooltip: Verify SSL certificates when making API requests. Recommended to keep enabled for security.

operations.title: Get IP Reputation
operations.description: Retrieve threat intelligence information for an IP address from CrowdSec CTI API

parameters.title: IP Address
parameters.name: ip_address
parameters.tooltip: Enter the IP address you want to investigate (IPv4 or IPv6)

operations.title: Search IP Reputation
operations.description: Search for IPs in CrowdSec CTI API using Lucene query filters

parameters.title: Query
parameters.name: query
parameters.tooltip: Lucene query string (e.g., behaviors.label:"SSH Bruteforce")

parameters.title: Since
parameters.name: since
parameters.tooltip: Filter results by time (e.g., 1m, 24h, 7d)

parameters.title: Page
parameters.name: page
parameters.tooltip: Page number of results (default: 1)

parameters.title: Limit
parameters.name: limit
parameters.tooltip: Maximum number of results per page (default: 10, max: 10 for community users)

operations.title: Batch Get IP Reputation
operations.description: Query batches of IPs in the CrowdSec CTI API for threat intelligence information

parameters.title: IP Addresses
parameters.name: ips
parameters.tooltip: Enter IP addresses to query (comma-separated or one per line). Example: 1.1.1.1, 8.8.8.8

operations.title: Get Fire IPs
operations.description: Retrieve a list of malevolent IP addresses from CrowdSec CTI, filtering by date of modification

parameters.title: Page
parameters.name: page
parameters.tooltip: The page to fetch (default: 1)

parameters.title: Limit
parameters.name: limit
parameters.tooltip: The number of items to fetch (default: 50, max: 1000)

parameters.title: Since
parameters.name: since
parameters.tooltip: Filter records updated since - duration in h (hours), d(days), m(minutes). Example: 3d
